rule: Per actor pair, per tick: skip beyond the processing range; an ally that was hit, or an ally already fighting the target, starts combat (ally cascade); a guard joins fights within the alarm radius. For player targets and player allies, an aggression score = Fight AI setting + distance bias + disposition bias, where distance bias = base - multiplier x distance and disposition bias = (50 - disposition) x multiplier; aggressive at score >= 100. Combat then starts only if line of sight and an awareness roll both pass. Wander: distance 0 means stationary; otherwise each 0.25 s reaction (deviation 0.1 s) starts a walk with 8% (path grid) or 4% (no path grid) chance, to a random point between 0.2 and 1.0 times the package distance from spawn; a game-setting roll gates idles, which pick one of eight idle groups by weight. Escort: while the leader is inside the current radius, walk (radius becomes half-extent + 450); when the leader is outside, stop with idle3 and set the radius to half-extent + 250, so resume needs the leader back inside the smaller radius.
keep: Aggro as a score: distance and disposition add to a fight term, one threshold.
Awareness gate: line of sight and a roll before combat starts.
Escort hysteresis: stop at the outer radius, resume only inside the inner radius, with a waiting idle.
Stationary lair as distance 0 (no walk, idle only).
Idle roll before any walk; walks rare in open ground.
Ally cascade for group fights, to be capped at 3 attackers in our build.
change: Our own constants, names and faction-standing input (disposition) per zone.
Seeded RNG for the awareness roll (server-verified replay).

look_test: Style-flag build on the existing scene: one guard by a path plus one escorted NPC, 375 wide, no release rows. Guard variants: A fixed radius at 6 tiles; B score ramp with no line-of-sight gate; C score ramp plus a wall that blocks the start. Escort variants: stop at 4.5 tiles and resume at 2.5 tiles, versus never stopping. Dom walks past each on his phone and says which reads as noticed and at what distance, and which escort reads as waiting for him.
